in_arabic.name: Aydeen
in_arabic.long_meaning: Aydeen هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic root 'Awd', meaning 'to help or aid'. In Islamic history, Aydeen is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for his unwavering support and assistance.
